summary_en: US-X Complete uses a single X-ray projection to provide complementary morphology for completing vertebral structures that are hidden by acoustic shadowing in 3D ultrasound. The multimodal deep model improves vertebral reconstruction over prior ultrasound-only completion methods and is validated on lumbar-spine phantoms, producing a more complete volumetric anatomy while keeping ultrasound as the primary imaging modality.
